Legendary Resistance (2/Day) If the slannethiss fails a Saving 
Th row, it can choose to succeed instead.
Amphibious Th e slannethiss can breathe both air and water. 
Sensory Horned Th e slannethiss has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks, and while underwater its twin horns allow 
the slannethiss to know the exact location of any other creature 
underwater for 100 ft..
Shoreline Stalker Th e slannethiss has Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks made to Hide while in the Strands or equivalent 
environments. In addition, while in dim light or darkness, the 
slannethiss can take the Hide action as a Bonus action.
Wickedly Fast Opportunity attacks against the slannethiss are 
made with Disadvantage.
Slippery If the slannethiss succeeds on a Dexterity Saving 
Th row, it takes no damage from effects that would deal half 
damage on Success.
Redirecting Charge Trigger: A creature the slannethiss can see 
hits it with a Lighting attack. Response - Constitution Saving Th row:
DC 5 + damage taken from the Lighting attack, the slannethiss. 
Success: Th e slannethiss targets one creature within 30 ft. of it to 
take half the redirected as Lightning damage.
Actions
Reactions
Legendary Actions
Legendary Action Uses 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another 
creature's turn, the slannethiss can expend a Legendary Action Use to 
take one of the following actions. Th e slannethiss regains all expended 
Legendary Actions at the start of each of its turns.
Quick Slash Th e slannethiss makes one Grasping Talons attack.
Slither Step Th e slannethiss moves up to half its speed, which 
doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an 
enemy’s reach.
Violent Instincts If the slannethiss is grappling a creature, it 
slams it against stone or the ground. Strength Saving Th row: DC 
16, one creature the slannethiss is grappling. Failure: 11 (2d10) 
Bludgeoning damage.
Grasping Talons Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one 
target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) Slashing damage. Dexterity Saving Th row: 
DC 16, Medium or smaller sized creature that the slannethiss 
has hit with its Grasping Talons attack. Failure: Target creature 
has the Grapple condition (escape DC 17). Th e slannethiss can 
grapple two creatures at a time.
Twisting Bite Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 17, 
Medium or smaller sized creature that the slannethiss has hit 
with its Twisting Bite attack. Failure: 22 (4d10) Slashing damage 
as the slannethiss whips its head back and forth.
Slapping Tail Melee Attack Roll: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 
Hit: 16 (2d10+5) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 15, 
one Medium or smaller creature the slannethiss has successfully 
hit with its Slapping Tail. Failure: Th e target is pushed back 5 ft. 
and has the Prone condition.
Senses Truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 19
Challenge 11 (XP 7,200; PB 4)
Skills Acrobatics +11, Perception +9, Stealth +11
Resistances Lightning, Slashing
Vulnerabilities Th under
Immunities Blindness, Charmed, Frightened
Scant Predators Th e slannethiss clears out most megafauna 
predators that encroach within 6 miles of its Lair, leaving 
only the scraps to feast upon. Re-roll the fi rst of any Hunting 
Expeditions that result in a predatory creature.
Nature Unbalanced Th e lack of larger predators allow many 
small herbivores within 5 miles of its Lair to flourish, and over 
consume the flora. Half the amount of discovered Resources 
rounding up, from the results of a Foraging Expeditions.
Fear's Shroud Creatures within 4 miles of the Lair of the 
slannethiss fear its nightly raids. Creatures have Disadvantage 
on Saving Th rows against the Frightened condition.
Savage Desperation Th e predators that remain within 3 miles 
of the Lair, attack unusually aggressively, influenced by a 
stalking apex predator. Creatures native to the Umbrawells have 
Advantage on Initiative rolls.
Foolish Scavengers Nearing 2 miles to the Lair, brave or foolhardy 
scavick flourish off the remains of the slannethiss' kills. Double 
the number of any scavick results from the Scavenger Table.
Tremor in the Water With its electric receptors picking up 
movement in the sea. Creatures within the water, 1 mile of the 
Lair must make a DC 16 Dexterity (Stealth) check to not alert the 
slannethiss of their presence.
Slinking into Shadow Th e slannethiss melds into the darkness. 
Until the start of its next turn, Ranged attack rolls against it are 
made with Disadvantage.
Tunnels in the Strands With innate sense of its coastal Strands 
home, the slannethiss disappears into a tight crevice of coral or 
stone. It reappears in a space it can see within 60 ft..
Choice Corals Grasping the clusters of a toxic breed of coral, the 
slannethiss throws it at an enemy within 30 ft. of it. Constitution 
Th row: DC 14, target creature. Failure: Target has the Paralyzed 
condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, 
ending the effect on itself on a success. After 3 minutes, it 
succeeds automatically.
Salt and Grit Th e slannethiss swipes its tail into the sand and 
water, spraying its enemies. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 13, 
each creature in a 20 ft. Cone. Failure: Target has the Blinded 
condition for 1 minute.
Aggressive Rush Th e slannethiss surges forward in a straight 
line up to 50 ft. toward a creature it can see. If the slannethiss 
reaches its target, it can immediately make a Grasping Bite 
attack against that creature.
[Seasonal] Collapsing Coast With a fi rm stomp the slannethiss 
breaks the earth and displaces a section of the coast. Th e 
slannethiss designates a 10 ft. square area adjacent to it. Th e 
terrain in that area becomes Diffi cult terrain.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the slannethiss 
takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects, the 
slannethiss can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row.
Lair Actions
Regional Effects
Within the coastal caves along the Strands, the slannethiss makes 
its lair, leaving it nightly to hunt, before returning, dragging its 
prey to feast.

Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) When an enemy creature within melee 
combat range of it is Bloodied, a thirsting hunger overtakes the beast.
On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 12, the slannethiss. Success: 
For the remainer of the combat encounter, the slannethiss' attack 
rolls have Advantage against the Bloodied creature.
Multiattack Th e slannethiss makes three attacks, using Crushing 
Tarsus, Heaving Bulk, Mandible Bite or Viscous Webbing in any 
combination.
